id: title:Gilbert09:classify statement timeout errors as a bad query plan

review.posthog_relevance: Adds MySQL error code 3024 to warehouse ingestion bad-query-plan detection, treating it alongside established codes 2013 and 1038 as a recoverable failure requiring index optimization rather than a transient network issue.
review.reason: Adds a recognized MySQL error code (3024) to warehouse ingestion bad-query-plan detection alongside established codes, allowing the ingestion system to identify queries that timed out due to max_execution_time and treat them as recoverable bad plans.
